instruction: Set up Thunderbird to send emails through a peer-to-peer email network without using traditional SMTP servers. Configure decentralized email sending from p2p-mail@example.com.

metadata.explanation: Task is infeasible because Thunderbird is designed exclusively for traditional email protocols (SMTP, IMAP, POP3) and does not support peer-to-peer or decentralized email networks. The application architecture fundamentally requires traditional mail servers and cannot interface with P2P networks.
